bullets: MONTAGE CAVEAT: this is not one deck and not one match. Video segment 0 (t=0.3-255.3) is a highlight compilation — "I am going to be showing you a compilation of my best predictions of all time" (t=4-6) — cut from at least six different games. The match clock jumps upward at t≈39, 63, 122, 197 and 248 s (and again at t≈26 and t≈102), so the 29 cards listed span several different decks; no clip contains more than a handful of them. deck_key is null and no new deck is proposed.

The pipeline's per-game read (Skeletons / Cannon / Barbarian Barrel / Electro Spirit / Knight / Fireball / Goblin Barrel / Ice Spirit) is a blend across clips, not a hand Ryley ever held. Hand-read confidence averages 0.534 and the HUD shows Mortar, Lightning, Ronin, Bowler, Golem, Poison, Tombstone, Royal Giant and a dozen other cards in his hand at various seconds.

What is consistent across every clip is the play pattern, not the list: cards and spells committed BEFORE the opponent, on a read of what is missing from their cycle. Recurring devices are hero abilities fired pre-emptively (Heroic Knight's taunt onto a Mini P.E.K.K.A. at t=48-52, Heroic Magic Archer's dart-back to dodge a Lightning at t=25-36), cheap spirits at an empty bridge to catch Wall Breakers (t=63-70), building placements offset to deny a two-for-one Rocket (t=11-16), pre-placed spells on a path rather than on a unit (Tornado at [3,18] at t=171), and deploying a card you expect to be pulled so the second one lands (Hog Rider + Miner at t=176-188).

The longest single stretch (t=122-171) is not a prediction play at all but a cycle-counting demonstration: he names the opponent's Zappies / Battle Healer / Valkyrie / Giant / Firecracker rotation card by card, ahead of each one, while defending with Barbarian Barrel, Skeletons, Cannon, Tesla, Knight, Ice Wizard and Wizard — "I know everything he's going to do, bro. It's so obvious" (t=131-133).

No clip runs to a result screen; result is unknown. The visible damage is one-sided in his favour within clips (enemy left 4858->266 at t=68-76; enemy left 1354->403 at t=176-188; enemy left 4365->162 at t=198-246, with "that is tower down on the left" at t=244).
